title: AI-based prediction of left bundle branch block risk post-TAVI using pre-implantation clinical parameters.
summary: Machine-learning models predict new left bundle branch block after TAVI from pre-implantation clinical parameters, a specific procedural-risk result. The cohort contains 1,113 consecutive TAVR patients at one cardiac center; post-procedure LBBB labels and pre-implant variables are compared across models. Testing: Single-center retrospective cohort over a long period with changes in practice; risk prediction is not a causal or clinical-utility result.. Source affiliation was not stated in the reviewed case checks and was unavailable in the local bibliographic cache.
